# Requirements Document

## 1. Application Overview

**Application Name**: PosifyPro Premium

**Description**: Transform the existing PosifyPro POS SaaS system into a premium modern SaaS platform with enterprise-grade design language inspired by MeDo.dev, while maintaining all current multi-tenant POS functionality including sales management, inventory control, reporting, and subscription billing.

---

## 2. Users and Usage Scenarios

**Target Users**:
- Super Admin: Platform administrators managing multiple tenants
- Business Owner: Retail business owners managing their stores
- Cashier: Front-line staff operating POS terminals

**Core Usage Scenarios**:
- Super Admin monitors platform health, tenant subscriptions, and revenue metrics
- Business Owner tracks sales performance, manages inventory, and analyzes business data
- Cashier processes customer transactions through POS interface

---

## 3. Page Structure and Functionality

```
PosifyPro Premium
├── Landing Page
├── Authentication
│   ├── Login
│   └── Registration
├── Super Admin Dashboard
│   ├── Overview
│   ├── Tenant Management
│   ├── Subscription Management
│   ├── Revenue Analytics
│   └── System Monitoring
├── Owner Dashboard
│   ├── Business Overview
│   ├── Sales Management
│   ├── Inventory Management
│   ├── Reports & Analytics
│   ├── Settings
│   └── Subscription & Billing
└── Cashier Dashboard
    ├── POS Sales Screen
    └── Transaction History
```

### 3.1 Landing Page

**Hero Section**:
- Display application value proposition with gradient background effects
- Animated KPI showcase cards highlighting platform capabilities
- Primary CTA buttons for registration and login

**Features Section**:
- Present core features in modern card layout
- Include icons and brief descriptions for each feature

**Testimonials Section**:
- Display customer testimonials with ratings

**Pricing Section**:
- Show subscription plans with feature comparison

**FAQ Section**:
- Common questions with expandable answers

**Footer**:
- Company information, links, and contact details
- Smooth scroll navigation to page sections

### 3.2 Authentication

**Login Page**:
- Email and password input fields
- Remember me option
- Forgot password link
- Redirect to appropriate dashboard based on user role

**Registration Page**:
- Business name, email, password, and confirmation fields
- Terms of service acceptance
- Create new tenant account and redirect to Owner Dashboard

### 3.3 Super Admin Dashboard

**Overview Page**:
- KPI Cards: Total Tenants, Active Subscriptions, Monthly Revenue, Annual Revenue, New Signups, Active Users, Churn Rate, System Health
- Charts: Revenue Trends (line chart), Subscription Growth (area chart), Tenant Growth (bar chart), Usage Analytics (line chart), Revenue by Plan (pie chart), MRR (area chart), Daily Active Users (bar chart)
- Activity Feed: Recent tenant activities and system events
- Quick Action Cards: Add Tenant, View Reports, System Settings

**Tenant Management**:
- Table displaying all tenants with columns: Tenant Name, Owner Email, Subscription Plan, Status, Created Date, Actions
- Search and filter by status, plan, date range
- Actions: View Details, Edit, Suspend, Delete

**Subscription Management**:
- Table showing all subscriptions with columns: Tenant, Plan, Status, Start Date, End Date, Amount, Actions
- Filter by plan type and status
- Actions: View Details, Modify Plan, Cancel

**Revenue Analytics**:
- Detailed revenue breakdown charts
- Export revenue reports

**System Monitoring**:
- System health metrics and alerts
- Performance indicators

### 3.4 Owner Dashboard

**Business Overview**:
- KPI Cards: Today's Sales, Weekly Sales, Monthly Sales, Gross Profit, Net Profit, Inventory Value, Low Stock Items, Top Selling Products
- Charts: Sales Trends (line chart), Product Performance (bar chart), Category Performance (pie chart), Profit Analysis (area chart), Customer Analytics (line chart), Inventory Movement (bar chart)
- Recent Transactions: Latest sales transactions list
- Business Insights: Key metrics and recommendations

**Sales Management**:
- View all sales transactions in table format
- Columns: Transaction ID, Date, Cashier, Items, Total Amount, Payment Method, Status
- Search by transaction ID, date range, cashier
- Export sales data

**Inventory Management**:
- Product list table with columns: Product Name, SKU, Category, Stock Quantity, Unit Price, Status, Actions
- Add new product functionality
- Edit product details
- Delete product
- Low stock alerts
- Search and filter by category, status

**Reports & Analytics**:
- Generate custom reports by date range and metrics
- Sales reports, inventory reports, profit reports
- Export reports in multiple formats

**Settings**:
- Business profile settings
- User management (add/edit/delete cashiers)
- Tax and payment settings
- Receipt customization

**Subscription & Billing**:
- Current subscription plan details
- Billing history table
- Upgrade/downgrade plan options
- Payment method management

### 3.5 Cashier Dashboard

**Overview**:
- KPI Cards: Today's Sales, Transactions Count, Current Shift Sales, Average Transaction Value
- Quick access to POS Sales Screen

**POS Sales Screen**:
- Product search and selection interface
- Shopping cart with selected items
- Item quantity adjustment
- Remove item from cart
- Apply discounts
- Calculate total amount including tax
- Payment method selection
- Process payment and generate receipt
- Clear cart after transaction

**Transaction History**:
- View cashier's own transaction history
- Columns: Transaction ID, Date, Items, Total Amount, Payment Method
- Search by date range

---

## 4. Business Rules and Logic

**Multi-Tenant Architecture**:
- Each tenant operates independently with isolated data
- Super Admin has access to all tenant data
- Owners can only access their own tenant data
- Cashiers can only access their assigned tenant's POS functions

**Subscription Management**:
- Tenants must have active subscription to access system
- Subscription expiration triggers account suspension
- Grace period of 7 days before data deletion

**Inventory Management**:
- Stock quantity decreases automatically after each sale
- Low stock threshold triggers alert when quantity falls below defined level
- Negative stock is not allowed

**Sales Processing**:
- Each transaction generates unique transaction ID
- Transaction records include timestamp, cashier ID, items, amounts, payment method
- Successful payment updates inventory and sales records

**User Permissions**:
- Super Admin: Full system access
- Owner: Access to own tenant's all modules except Super Admin functions
- Cashier: Access only to POS Sales Screen and own transaction history

**Data Calculation**:
- Gross Profit = Total Sales - Cost of Goods Sold
- Net Profit = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
- Average Transaction Value = Total Sales / Number of Transactions

---

## 5. Exceptions and Edge Cases

| Scenario | Handling |
|----------|----------|
| User enters invalid login credentials | Display error message, allow retry |
| Subscription expires during active session | Show expiration notice, redirect to billing page |
| Product out of stock during checkout | Prevent adding to cart, show out of stock message |
| Network error during payment processing | Show error message, allow retry, do not deduct inventory |
| Duplicate product SKU during creation | Display validation error, prevent creation |
| Super Admin attempts to delete tenant with active subscription | Show confirmation dialog with warning |
| Cashier attempts to access Owner Dashboard | Redirect to Cashier Dashboard, show permission denied message |
| Chart data is empty | Display \"No data available\" message |
| Export operation fails | Show error notification, allow retry |
| Session timeout | Redirect to login page, preserve unsaved data if possible |

---

## 6. Acceptance Criteria

1. User registers new business account and successfully logs in as Owner
2. Owner navigates to Inventory Management and adds a new product with name, SKU, price, and stock quantity
3. Owner creates a cashier user account from Settings page
4. Cashier logs in and accesses POS Sales Screen
5. Cashier searches for the product, adds it to cart, processes payment, and completes transaction
6. Owner views the completed transaction in Sales Management and confirms inventory quantity decreased
7. Owner checks Business Overview dashboard and verifies Today's Sales reflects the transaction amount
8. Super Admin logs in and views the tenant in Tenant Management table with active subscription status

---

## 7. Features Not Included in This Release

- Mobile native applications for iOS/Android
- Customer loyalty program and membership management
- Multi-location management for chain stores
- Employee scheduling and shift management
- Advanced CRM features (customer segmentation, marketing campaigns)
- Integration with third-party accounting software
- Barcode scanner hardware integration
- Kitchen display system for restaurants
- Table management for dine-in services
- Online ordering and delivery management
- Multi-currency support
- Multi-language interface
- Advanced fraud detection and security features
- API access for third-party integrations
- White-label customization options
- Offline mode functionality
- Advanced inventory forecasting and auto-reordering
- Employee commission tracking
- Gift card and voucher management
- Customer feedback and review system
